capabilities: convert a selected DNA sequence to its reverse complement
access the conversion via the right-click context menu
extras: The README focuses on release instructions rather than usage; installation guidance is only a link elsewhere.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to reverse-complement DNA sequences in text selections, which biologists may want inside their notes.
summary: Utility that adds a right-click menu command to convert a selected DNA sequence into its reverse complement.
